messages.subject: Weighted boxplots not working
parts:
Hello,

I have a bit of an odd issue.  It seems like weighted boxplots are not working for me at all.  When i test my shiny app locally, it works fine, but after publishing the boxplots do not appear (a plot window with the grey background, axis labels, but no boxplots appears).

A toy example to reproduce is, in a renderPlot expression:

qplot(Month, Day, data = airquality, weight = Temp, geom = "boxplot", group = Month)

For me this works when calling runApp() but not with deployApp(). Any idea why this would not be working?  I can provide a full ui.R and server.R if it would be helpful.

Eric

messages.author: e84e7628b5f8a3e1
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Weighted boxplots not working
parts:
Eric,

According to Hadley:

"Weighted boxplots require the quantreg package, but there should be an error if it's not present."

You can force shinyapps to install the quantreg package by including an explicit call to "library(quantreg)" in your server.R or UI.R. 

When you call deployApp(), only packages that are loaded via library(), and their required dependancies are deployed to server.

Let me know if that helps.

-Andy
